en: A vintage, colorized postcard showing a grand, bustling city boulevard lined with ornate historic buildings. Several streetcars and carriages travel along a wide avenue shaded by trees, while pedestrians walk on sidewalks. The architecture is late 19th/early 20th century European, with domes and intricate facades. Prominent large dome-roofed buildings are visible, with the scene suffused in pastel shades. Text in several languages appears at the top.
